about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

caWhole(whole) restores the full DFHCOMMAREA array after a task whose area was cut to EIBCALEN (X23); a restore skipped leaves the cut array, which only matters to a later reference past EIBCALEN, and COUSR03C reads DFHCOMMAREA only as DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN); each task starts by copying the full image back in initialState

COUSR03C reads only EIBCALEN and EIBAID of DFHEIBLK; runTask stores EIBCALEN each task and EIBAID from the scenario's key (an unmapped key keeps the initial byte, which like a space or NUL matches none of DFHENTER / DFHPF3 / DFHPF4 / DFHPF5 / DFHPF12, so takes WHEN OTHER); every EIBRESP is stored by its command before the generator reads it, and the rest is never read

heldKey carries a READ UPDATE's key to the DELETE of the same task; COUSR03C's DELETE-USER-SEC-FILE always follows READ-USER-SEC-FILE in the same pass, whose put replaces the entry, so a key left from an earlier task is never used

without the first entry's MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COUSR3AO the first SEND MAP sends the map's VALUE image (spaces) in its fields instead of low-values: a different 3270 data stream, but equivalence_cics._same and the screen values strip trailing spaces AND low-values, so the proof cannot see it (#4635)
the 'Y' written for an invalid key is never tested afterwards: the SEND that follows does not read ERR-FLG, MAIN-PARA ends in RETURN, and the next task starts from MAIN-PARA's SET ERR-FLG-OFF

`CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES AND = SPACES` for OR: every caller of RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN moves a program name into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM first ('COSGN00C', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM when it is not blank, else 'COADM01C'), so it is neither, and both conditions are false
no statement of COUSR03C reads EIBRESP (every command names RESP(WS-RESP-CD) or none), DFHEIBLK is not compared, and each command stores EIBRESP afresh before the generator reads it
condition() returns a value only for a handled, ignored or ERROR-handled condition; COUSR03C sets no handler, so after a failed XCTL it throws (the abend) and `to` is never tested

a received CURTIME (FSET) is no longer stored: CURTIMEI is never read, POPULATE-HEADER-INFO writes CURTIMEO (the same bytes) before every SEND, and CURTIMEL is read only by SEND MAP's cursor test, which RECEIVE never sets
